'''Quintik Kahr''', better known as '''"Big Quince"''', was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]-based [[Sludir]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] and the brother of [[Omze'kehr Kahr]]. Before turning to slavery, he was a famous [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]], fighting primarily in the pits of [[Loovria/Legends|Loovria]], using a [[Force pike/Legends|force pike]] that he would carry for the rest of his life.

Kahr's base of operations was the immense slave [[Starship/Legends|ship]] that was called ''[[Quincey's Girl]]''. He was exceptionally skilled at dealing with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] customs officers, bribing them with [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]], [[Gruvian Tovash]], slave girls and the like, and thus had few problems with the Empire.

Quintik Kahr was the owner of [[Tru'eb Cholakk]] and [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]], the latter of whom he intended to give to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Antoll Jellrek]] as part of a bribe. However, both Cholakk and Okeefe managed to escape.
